purpose: Forward-only correction of P2-A evidence interpretation. P2-A's historical final-verdicts.json is NOT modified; what was actually demonstrated is preserved and the overstatement is corrected here.

erratum.p2aClaim: the Level C gate's 'no model turn ran' was supported by 'turnEventCountInWrittenSessions: 0'
erratum.whatWasActuallyDemonstrated: the gate text-scanned a Zstandard-compressed artifact as UTF-8, which can never contain the scanned literal; the value 0 is a property of the measurement method, not of the session
erratum.correction: the zero is VACUOUS as a runtime measurement. The no-model claim at P2-A rested entirely on the STRUCTURAL exclusion (the capability refusal is thrown between agents.create and the only agent.followup call), which remains valid and independently verifiable from source
erratum.impactOnP2aVerdict: the structural no-model argument is unaffected; the runtime MEASUREMENT was overstated
erratum.p2bResolution: B0-C2 reads the logical Session Event stream through the official DSH reader and reports the actual turn/start, step/start and request event counts

erratum.p2aClaim: the first-party gate qualified the identity route
erratum.whatWasActuallyDemonstrated: the gate did run against the real Host Bundle on this machine and did observe a real worker-<uuid> matching a written session; the qualification was genuine
erratum.correction: the gate's WRAPPER could also have returned a passing assertion without running when DSH/dist were absent; the qualification was genuine on the machine it ran, but the wrapper was not a non-vacuous gate
erratum.impactOnP2aVerdict: no change to the observed result; the gate's FAILURE MODE was under-specified
erratum.p2bResolution: the P2-B first-party gate reports an explicit outcome vocabulary and the wrapper asserts execution actually occurred

erratum.p2aClaim: the identity observation carries a `sourceQualification` field
erratum.whatWasActuallyDemonstrated: the field exists and is recorded
erratum.correction: the field is a CALLER-SUPPLIED HINT. P2-A's Level C gate passed 'FIRST_PARTY_DSH_QUALIFIED' itself. The label is not independent verification of the executable's provenance and must never authorize a durable binding on its own
erratum.impactOnP2aVerdict: the observation semantics are unchanged; the label's epistemic weight was over-read
erratum.p2bResolution: B0-C3 defines the trusted source chain and requires read-side qualification from trusted deployment facts and actual DSH reads

erratum.p2aClaim: the P2-A tracker handles identity conflict
erratum.whatWasActuallyDemonstrated: the tracker distinguishes a first identity from a single conflicting identity (A vs B)
erratum.correction: with three or more distinct identities the tracker retains only two slots, so an intermediate identity is LOST
erratum.impactOnP2aVerdict: no change for the two-identity case P2-A actually exercised; the cardinality bound was not disclosed
erratum.p2bResolution: the durable model preserves every distinct observation; conflict is derived from the full candidate set
